description_en: Creates an access control list (ACL) for a private gateway. The IP CIDR blocks added to the ACL can access the private gateway
description_zh: 创建私有网关的访问权限，添加权限的IP段可以访问网关
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-acl-policy --cluster-id cn-wulanchabu --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --vpc-id vpc-uf66uio7md0000 --acl-policy-list Comment=default Entry=10.23.XX.XX/32 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAclPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the private gateway
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The private gateway ID. To obtain the private gateway ID, see the private_gateway_id parameter in the response parameters of the ListResources operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见ListResources接口返回结果中的private_gateway_id字段
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information about how to obtain the VPC ID, see DescribeVpcs
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络的ID。如何获取专有网络ID，请参见DescribeVpcs
parameters.name: vpc_id

element_fields.help_en: The IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway
element_fields.name: entry

element_fields.help_en: The comment on the IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway
element_fields.help_zh: 专有网络可访问IP段备注
element_fields.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The whitelisted IP CIDR blocks in the VPC that can access the private gateway
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络可访问IP段白名单列表
parameters.name: acl_policy_list
